## What's changed

- Fixed modern-player pairing appearing to time out after the server had already accepted and saved the player.
- Made the initial Home response read the local-media index once instead of reparsing it for every TV series.
- Limited Recently Added episode artwork and play-state preparation to the cards actually returned on Home, keeping startup responsive with large libraries.
- Preserved the grouped Recently Added episode behavior for Steam, Apple TV, and Google TV players.
